name: CeraLyte 70 Rice-Based Oral Rehydration Solution
whyItWorks: The clinical gold-standard ORS for short bowel syndrome, severe Crohn's enteritis, and high-output ileostomies. Uses rice carbohydrate polymers instead of simple sugars, allowing continuous enzyme-mediated sodium absorption that reduces stool volume and stops diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 1 packet with 32 oz (1 liter) of clean water. Sip throughout the day as prescribed by your gastroenterologist or GI dietitian.
